title: Temperature response of defect photoluminescence in locally functionalized single-walled carbon nanotubes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4137-4148
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08569H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ryo Hamano, Yoshiaki Niidome, Naoki Tanaka, Tomohiro Shiraki, Tsuyohiko Fujigaya
Near-infrared emission from low-density defects in single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) functions as a highly sensitive thermometer, with its sensitivity varying depending on factors such as the defect structure and the length of the SWCNTs.
